tables.name: Submission Assets
tables.description:
Operational asset table tied to submission records.

Use this table to store files, generated assets, or supporting writeback/output records connected to a Submission and related Enrollment.

This table supports downstream processing and asset management. It should be treated as an operational support table, not as the primary activity-entry table.

fields.name: Ready to Send to Make?
fields.description: Checks if all required fields are present for sending to Make, using correct field names.

optionsSummary.formula:
IF(
  COUNTA({fldrGt7IsWDUAKfzD}) = 0,
  "Missing: Airtable Attachment",

  IF(
    {fldox2Rjj9YL3EYK6} = "",
    "Missing: Upload Destination",

    IF(
      {fldox2Rjj9YL3EYK6} = "Ignore",
      "Skipped: Destination Ignore",

      IF(
        {fldox2Rjj9YL3EYK6} = "Homework Completions",
        IF(
          OR(
            COUNTA({fldQF8OsfESrHdcUb}) > 0,
            {fld8pLfrA76vMP5mt} != ""
          ),
          "READY_TO_SEND",
          "Missing: Homework Completions Link or RID"
        ),

        IF(
          {fldox2Rjj9YL3EYK6} = "Video Feedback",
          IF(
            COUNTA({fldxapOLpLH4KaXOb}) > 0,
            "READY_TO_SEND",
            "Missing: Video Feedback Link"
          ),

          "Bad Destination: " & {fldox2Rjj9YL3EYK6}
        )
      )
    )
  )
)
